bounds.basis: Lyon Table IV prints 1000 MW net (the branch default); 891.0016527219543 is this case's own net, so the branch then substitutes the source capital scope alone.
bounds.missing_response: The source-conditioned branch substitutes a supplied denominator and already-financed capital; nothing physical responds.

bounds.basis: E7/F8 allowance 70 M [35, 140]; 80,893,344 is target-derived from Lyon's 14 % of CoE (source-boundary), labelled diagnostic.
bounds.missing_response: Fixed allowance; no staffing or maintenance model responds.

bounds.basis: F3 40 [30, 60]; 47 = 40 full-power years / 0.85 rounded to the integer the model requires.
bounds.missing_response: Financial assumption; no financing, liability or service-life evidence responds; no engineering optimum.

bounds.basis: E8 5 [2, 8]; 3.7673466400138413 = 5 x 1468.361/1948.8 (fluence-scaled applicability point); 2.907407 = source cadence 15.7/5.4 (E8).
bounds.missing_response: Selected life; no damage or fluence model responds.

bounds.basis: E8 1 [0.5, 2]; 1.038330309484732 = 75,000,000 / 72,231,350 (source event price over the selected scope).
bounds.missing_response: Event price factor; no procurement model.

bounds.basis: F7: 0 (no credit), 100 (named scenario), 50, 150; 138.7304019114013 equals this case's gross makeup (purchase floor / self-sufficiency diagnostic).
bounds.missing_response: Net extracted breeder feed has no qualified capability or extraction-cost model; exhaust recycling is already credited.

bounds.missing_response: Incremental assumed service cost has no price-versus-capability relation.

bounds.missing_response: The 0.95 recuperator has no purchase, rating or screen (audit item 1).

bounds.basis: Flow-proportional proxy 1700/1400 = 1.214 and the E4 upper bound 1.5.

bounds.basis: 1700 (the declared alternative); 1600 adverse control (screen fails by 67.033 MW).
bounds.missing_response: Scalar screen and linear cost; no compressor map.
